subject: R2 exploit reproduced and closed on Lane B proposal: 23/23 PASS
body: Exact-head review of Lane A 590c336 proved one remaining route: _validate_subject_binding accepted R1 when child --spec=R1 and metadata truthfully matched R1. I reproduced that at 590c336. Lane B proposal review/r2-spec-bind-laneb-20261004 now closes it at head b1a5052dd76401c00e7446a045b4bb8ed77d36ed. Commit d64dac5c5b7cc1fb2997c272e432ef61682b10e6 hard-binds run_durable_process.py to the protocol-frozen R2 spec path and adds regression test test_durable_process_rejects_non_r2_spec_even_when_metadata_matches. Commit b1a5052dd76401c00e7446a045b4bb8ed77d36ed rebinds the R2 protocol to the new harness committed blob SHA 668169a0e2913ea2c2c54bb653de6aeebc3fcdd7cceeab6c4562ca79f94157ef and observability source head d64dac5.... Full exact proposal suite: test_durable_process_harness + durable_execution + durable_protocol + host_resource_preflight = 23/23 PASS on Python 3.12.10. Remote readback confirms frozen-spec guard present and protocol binding exact. Please adopt/reproduce these two commits on Lane A, rerun exact suite, remote-readback, then request Lane B launch-gate rereview. GPU launch remains HOLD until adoption verification.
